# Real decklists

Top-8 decklists from MTGTop8, fetched from the MTGO export of each deck: Standard in `decks/` ([format page](https://www.mtgtop8.com/format?f=ST), fetched 2026-10-14), Pioneer in `pioneer/` and Modern in `modern/` ([Pioneer](https://www.mtgtop8.com/format?f=PI), [Modern](https://www.mtgtop8.com/format?f=MO), fetched 2026-10-15). Card text in `cards.json` was copied from [mtg.wtf](https://mtg.wtf), [Archidekt](https://archidekt.com) or the magicthegathering.io API (each card's `source` field names the site), because Scryfall is blocked from the environment these fixtures were built in. The cards are stored in the same shape as Scryfall card objects, with `legalities` for the three formats. Snow-covered basics and Wastes were added by hand. Deserted Beach is marked legal in Standard because two of the Standard decks, one from MTGO, play it; the card site listed it as not legal.
